packet_defects: F1 and F2 carry no caption and no data: F1 is the TOC/abstract rendering, F2 is a journal cover thumbnail. Both are nonetheless offered as whole-figure panels, so 'panels offered' overstates the usable panel count (13 offered, 11 usable).
Packet figure ids are offset by two from the paper's own numbering: F3=paper Fig. 1, F4=Fig. 2, F5=Fig. 3, F6=Fig. 4.

F5 is tier C3_caption_swap with no crops offered. The caption's 'blue dash-dot lines' marking the polaritonic states are not discernible in the packet image, so the 2+1=3 branch count was taken from F6a instead and F5-backed nodes carry image_support partial.
F4b/F4c: splittings read by eye (~110 and ~65 cm-1) exceed the caption's 101 and 46 cm-1; recorded in o5/n11 image_note.
Simulated cavity thicknesses in the F5 caption (10.8 / 8.5 / 10.4 um) do not match the fitted thicknesses in the F6 linked text (9.7 / 8.0 / 10.1 um) for the same three systems; raised as audit a3.
Every headline number (220, 202, 172, 41, 18, 70, 84 cm-1) lives in the linked text; Figure S6, Figure S7 and Table S2, which carry the fits behind them, are not in the packet.
